ozelAlanlar.tanimAciklama: Define extra information fields for records. They can be used in rule conditions and email variables (e.g. aday.ozel.<key>); project and support fields can optionally be shown to the client read-only.
ozelAlanlar.silOnay: Delete the field "{{ad}}"? (It can be restored from the trash; values are kept.)
ozelAlanlar.bos: No custom fields for this record type.

form.bos: There is no CRM lead custom field that can be asked in a form (text, number, URL, choice); add one under Automation > Custom fields.
form.ipucu: The visitor's answer is saved to the lead's custom field. The field name is shown as the label in the form.
